months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr']
sales = [1200, 1500, 900, 1800]

title = 'Monthly Sales'
xlabel = 'Month'
ylabel = 'Sales'

try:
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(months, sales, color='steelblue')
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
    plt.close(fig)
except ImportError:
    # matplotlib unavailable: render a simple text bar chart instead
    print(title)
    print(ylabel + ' by ' + xlabel)
    for m, s in zip(months, sales):
        print(f"{m:>4} | {'#' * (s // 100)} {s}")
